comment: Horde (UE-only; Combat/HordeRules.h, UHordeSubsystem). ONE trigger (game designer 2026-11-09): horde #12 - after N firefights IN A ROW on the level (level JSON "horde_after_firefights", default 10; UFirefightSubsystem / FirefightRules.h); the old horde after 240 s of real-time fight (trigger_seconds / repeats / repeat_seconds / count_increase_per_repeat, user request 2026-10-06) was removed 2026-11-09 and those keys are ignored. A firefight = one encounter with the level's enemies (patrols, ambushers, PMC) started by contact in which shots were exchanged with an aware enemy, or an ambush sprung on the squad; it ends when its enemies are down or after firefight_lost_contact_seconds without contact; slipping past an enemy group undetected (the squad came within its detection reach = its vision range clamped to firefight_slip_min/max_reach_m, it never spotted the squad, the squad left the reach x firefight_slip_exit_factor) resets the streak when firefight_slip_past_resets (confirmed by the game designer 2026-11-09); the HQ hints firefight_hint_before firefights early (1 = at 9 of 10), warns firefight_warning_seconds before the horde, then the horde intro. Per level: the level JSON "horde_enabled": false switches it off (2026-11-09: on at the Depot, off at the Lake and the PMC arenas), an optional "horde": { ...same keys... } overrides these values. Distances in meters, times in seconds. composition = weights per level-JSON enemy type (HOUND / FROST_HOUND, FROSTBITTEN, MILITARY_ZOMBIE = a Frostbitten variant Blueprint, BRUTE, CUTTER, MARKSMAN, CRYO_DRONE); the SPITTER is refused (the Military Zombie took its place outside the stage waves, horde #12 / task #34, confirmed by the game designer 2026-11-09). Console: Codex.Horde.Enabled / Codex.Horde.AfterFirefights / Codex.Horde.FirefightWarningSeconds (-1 = data), CodexTactics.Horde.Release (direct release, no warning).
